assumptions: Authored settlement mix, not observational inference: frontier-heavy 40/35/20/5 percent with Hamilton quotas.
Systems ranked by SHA256(version, system ID); independent hash selects an inclusive profile total.
Targets include the accepted initial bulk market. Existing unrelated markets remain untouched and are reported separately at target preflight.
Roles are descriptive only. Every addition retains full ordinary inventory, hourly restock and default ship listings; no research or repair mechanics.

Circular generated-planet orbits, then fully specified catalog-planet fallback, require 1000 km surface, moon (including radius), ring and all-phase station-envelope clearance, within 0.1 periapsis Hill radius.
Analytic Kepler envelopes are conservative screening, not N-body certification. Unknown geometry or exhausted search holds the system; never silently lower a target.
